name: Halberd
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 19, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 143
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 19, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 143
Statistics
Cost 10 gp Weight 12 lbs.
Damage 1d8 (small), 1d10 (medium); Critical x3; Range —; Type P or S; Special brace, trip
Category Two-Handed; Proficiency Martial
Weapon Groups Polearms
Description
A halberd is similar to a 5-foot-long spear, but it also has a small, axelike head mounted near the tip.
